alt: Letter from Department of Managed Health Care requesting additional information.
summary: This letter from the Department of Managed Health Care (DMHC) informs Nicolas Hernandez that additional information is required to process his Independent Medical Review (IMR)/Complaint Form. He must submit the requested details, including a specific information sheet, by August 20, 2026, via email, fax, or mail, or his complaint will be closed. Failure to respond by the deadline will result in the closure of the complaint, though a new case can be opened.

DEPARTMENT OF Managed Health Care

August 13, 2026

NICOLAS HERNANDEZ
[Redacted Address]
CA 9[Redacted Zip]

Gavin Newsom, Governor
State of California
Health and Human Services Agency
DEPARTMENT OF MANAGED HEALTH CARE
980 9th Street, Suite 500
Sacramento, CA 95814
Toll-Free: 1-888-466-2219 | Fax: 916-255-5241
Email: helpline@dmhc.ca.gov
www.DMHC.ca.gov

Patient: Nicolas Hernandez
DMHC#: [Redacted]23
Health Plan: Local Initiative Health Authority for L.A. County (L.A. Care Health Plan)

Dear Nicolas Hernandez:

Thank you for sending your Independent Medical Review (IMR)/Complaint Form to the Department of Managed Health Care (Department).

You are receiving this letter because additional information is required to process your request. Please refer to the "Requested Information Sheet" on Page 3 of this letter for the specific information needed.

Please submit the requested information along with the Requested Information Sheet (Page 3 of this letter) to the Department no later than August 20, 2026. Please note you must include the Requested Information Sheet (Page 3) to ensure the information you submit is attached to your case.

The quickest way to return this information to the Department is by sending it via email to helpline@dmhc.ca.gov or by fax to 916-255-5241. If either of those two options are not available to you, the requested information can be mailed to:

Department of Managed Health Care
Help Center
980 9th Street Suite 500
Sacramento CA 95814

If you are unable to respond with the requested information by August 20, 2026, your complaint will be closed. You may use the enclosed IMR Application/Complaint Form to request that a new case be opened. You may also file an online IMR Application/Complaint Form at www.DMHC.ca.gov.

Protecting the Health Care Rights of More Than 30.2 Million Californians
Contact the DMHC Help Center at 1-888-466-2219 or www.DMHC.ca.gov
